player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I manually counted the vertices in the path string instead of using a more robust method to determine the number of segments. While my count of 5 vertices was correct for this specific case, relying on manual counting is error-prone and slow. Next time, I will immediately count the number of "L" characters in the `d` attribute string, as each "L" represents a line segment connecting two vertices, and the number of segments equals the number of sides for a closed polygon. I will then match this count directly to the options (e.g., 5 segments = pentagon) without re-deriving the geometry or listing all options unnecessarily.
